notes: Presentation only. Each generated civilization is shown through one official main culture (installed SPCultures, is_main_culture=true, merged catalog campaign_catalog-10212), so its troops, buildings, scenes and character art come from installed assets. Generated culture ids, names and labels are preserved as metadata with provenance. Missing source-specific art never blocks a world. An unlisted civilization is an unresolved mandatory reference and fails the compile. Values that depend on this choice are typed pending slots in campaign.json: each kingdom's troopTreeAndRecruitTemplates and each hero's characterTemplate (MMR-32), and town and village economy (MMR-33). The 12 entries are exactly the generator's civilization registry (FWGC++ generated/content_civilizations.cpp kEntityIds); campaign_semantics_tests checks that.
